replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes. When faced with complex formulas or abstract concepts, I can feel that familiar knot of anxiety tighten in my chest. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I've experimented with AI tools recently. It's been a double-edged sword; while it offers quick explanations that help me grasp concepts faster, I sometimes worry about relying too much on it without truly understanding the underlying logic myself.
